label: Only 52% of callers reach a person
detail: Over 70 million calls analyzed across home services and restoration. Nearly half of callers never speak to anyone.
source: Invoca Home Services Lead Conversion Benchmarks Report

label: Call a competitor if you do not answer
detail: When an emergency or service call is missed, 82% of homeowners will dial your competitor instead of waiting.

label: Call another business immediately
detail: One in five homeowners immediately dial another service business the second your phone stops ringing without pickup.

label: Value after-hours AI answering
detail: Consumers state that companies using responsive after-hours AI assistants project superior, reliable customer service.
